assessment.nobel_worthiness: Turns a biological process (ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis) into a designable chemical reaction: bifunctional molecules and molecular glues induce proximity to an E3 ligase and drive degradation of targets previously considered undruggable. Original, general, and mechanistically well defined; the kind of chemistry that gives biologists and medicine a general tool.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies (founding PROTAC concept, 2001) and Ciulli (structure-based VHL ligands, ternary-complex mechanism) are the clearest trio; the thalidomide/cereblon molecular-glue story (Handa, Ito, Kim, Sakamoto, Gray) is a second thread whose credit may be difficult to fit in the same prize.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent confirmation across many labs and targets, with multiple degraders in advanced clinical trials, though no approved PROTAC drug yet. The mechanistic picture is stable; clinical validation is still maturing, so timing is slightly early.
uncertainties: Whether PROTACs and molecular glues should be recognized together or separately
Clinical benefit not yet fully established by approvals
Cannot independently verify exact credit sequence and dates from memory

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts one nucleobase to another using the chemistry of cytidine and adenosine deamination on DNA without double-strand breaks. Elegant protein/chemistry design (including evolved adenosine deaminase acting on DNA), broadly adopted, with direct relevance to genome fidelity and disease.
assessment.attribution: Liu is the clear intellectual leader; Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor) were the lead experimentalists. Nishida and Kondo (Target-AID) were parallel inventors, which complicates a clean configuration, but the supplied names allow Liu with the two lead authors.
assessment.maturity: Reproduced widely, and in vivo and clinical use is beginning, including individualized therapy. Technology is mature enough for recognition; bystander edits and off-target (including RNA and DNA off-target deamination) issues are being engineered around.
uncertainties: Overlap with CRISPR prizes (Chemistry 2020) and relation to prime editing (B038)
Long-term clinical safety data still limited

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chemical genetics of kinases (analog-sensitive alleles) and covalent targeting of the KRAS G12C switch-II pocket cracked a target long considered undruggable. A clear chemical mechanism, trapping an inactive-state cysteine, that led directly to approved drugs.
assessment.attribution: A single-laureate configuration is natural: Shokat's lab discovered the tethering-based allosteric pocket and the chemical-genetic strategy. Drug development at Amgen and Mirati built on it, but the discovery attribution is clean.
assessment.maturity: Independently confirmed by approved drugs (sotorasib, adagrasib) and extensive structural work; the interpretation is stable and recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Whether the committee prefers to honor the drug-discovery application or the broader chemical-genetics concept
Industry contributions to clinical compounds are outside the credited list

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminators and single-molecule clusters is a chemistry-enabled method that transformed biology and medicine, and also enables genome-wide dNTP-level, mutational and replication studies relevant to my field. Impact is enormous and lasting.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded Solexa chemistry and the approach; Ju (alternative terminators), Mayer (clustering) and Rothberg (pyrosequencing/454, a different method) complicate credit. Two laureates is the most defensible fit, with some residual dispute.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature and used worldwide for roughly two decades; timing is overdue if anything.
uncertainties: Dispute over credit between clustering, reversible terminator and pyrosequencing lineages
Whether the committee views this as chemistry or as biotechnology/medicine

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles, with pH-dependent charge and controlled self-assembly, made nucleic-acid medicines deliverable and enabled mRNA vaccines and siRNA drugs. Major lasting impact with a clear physicochemical rationale.
assessment.attribution: Cullis led foundational LNP and ionizable-lipid work; Anderson and Langer contributed lipidoid and polymer delivery; MacLachlan, Madden, Hope were core to the Vancouver/Tekmira lineage. The attribution is spread over many people and companies and is difficult to resolve to three.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by COVID-19 vaccines and approved siRNA drugs, so it is mature; the 2023 Medicine prize recognized the mRNA side, which affects how the committee frames it.
uncertainties: Cannot verify precise lipid design priority

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Single-molecule electrical readout of nucleic acids through protein pores turned a physical measurement into a sequencing and chemical sensing technology. Original and generalizable with analytical chemistry at its core.
assessment.attribution: Deamer, Branton and Kasianowicz proposed and first demonstrated the concept; Bayley engineered pores and Akeson showed enzyme-controlled DNA translocation. A fair three-person split is arguable but contested.
assessment.maturity: Commercialized and used widely, with replicated results across many groups; accuracy limitations are improving, and long-read applications are well established. Timing is reasonable.
uncertainties: Attribution between concept originators and engineers
Dispute over whether an instrument/method prize falls in Chemistry

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based probes use enzyme mechanism-based covalent chemistry to read out functional state of enzymes in native proteomes. Turns enzymology into a general proteome-wide tool, and I value the measurement of activity over abundance.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt is the central figure with the proteomic platform; Bogyo and Overkleeft developed probes for proteases and proteasome and extended the concept to cells and in vivo. Weerapana is a collaborator and less central.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced with many probe classes and drug-discovery uses; stable and mature, though its single decisive breakthrough is less crisp than others on my list.
uncertainties: Whether credit should be limited to one or two laureates
Degree of independence of the Bogyo/Overkleeft thread

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids via evolved orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs and reprogrammed codons expanded the chemistry of proteins in living cells. Original, general, and a clear chemical redesign of a biological process.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the orthogonal-pair method and Wang was his co-lead in the first eukaryote/E. coli work; Chin extended it to mammalian cells, multi-site and quadruplet-codon systems. Mehl and Yokoyama contributed in parallel, so the three-way split is reasonable but not unique.
assessment.maturity: Replicated and used in many labs for two decades; stable and mature. Some reduction of immediate novelty compared with newer tools, but recognition is not premature.
uncertainties: Competing claims from Mehl and Yokoyama
Overlap with the 2018 directed-evolution prize in the committee's mind
